findings.reason: the assertion has to be per figure and against the builder's returned shape and spacing, or one of the four figures is signed off as regenerated without having been drawn from a §5 map.
findings.text: §6 done-when (1) discriminates with "asserts that shape is the §5 map's and not 33×33", but the full-axis lane's committed artefact is already 65×65 (`docs/figures/mast-centroid-capability/full-axis-lane/panel-fields.npz`, `shape [65 65]`) with its contours still a lattice raster, so the clause passes on the unfixed figure and cannot show that figure was redrawn; §6's own premise, "their thin contours are still the 33×33 lattice raster", is likewise false for that lane

findings.reason: §6 can close with non-converged panels whose captions still present the stopped iterate as the solved field, which is the exact misreading §5 was revised to prevent.
findings.text: §5 requires that "a panel of a non-converged state says in its caption that it draws the field of the terminal currents, and gives that mismatch", and §7 done-when (1) carries that clause, but §6's done-when has none, while its cpu lane's receipt records `warm_converged_count = 2` (`docs/figures/mast-centroid-capability/cpu-lane/centroid-solve.json`), so the fleet it redraws includes non-converged states

findings.reason: the node needs the plan to say that figure is re-solved from its producer without a stored state and that done-when (2) creates the npz, otherwise the fifth figure either cannot be closed on the stated measure or closes vacuously.
findings.text: §7 states "Their `panel-states.npz` files keep ψ only, so each is re-solved with the producer command that wrote it", but `docs/figures/single-grid-solver-cutover/` contains `titan-converged-vs-nonconverged.png` and `.svg` and no `panel-states.npz` at all, so for that figure there is no stored state to re-solve from and no file for done-when (2) to carry currents into

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — §7 asserts a `panel-states.npz` behind each of its five figures, and `docs/figures/single-grid-solver-cutover/` holds none.
rubric_items.done_when: two findings — §6 done-when (1)'s "not 33×33" discriminator already holds on the unfixed full-axis artefact, and §6 carries no caption clause for the non-converged panels §5 requires captioned.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — receipts and the npz states land under `docs/figures/...` in git, alongside the figures they describe, not in a scratchpad or a node-local path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, ticket numbers or version tags reach a symbol the units create; "§5 map" appears only in plan prose, not in a name the work would carry.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the 2026-11-02 saddle-cell observation supports the interpolation root cause, the fine-map mechanism is capable of each done-when, and the caller is named at both consumers (`benchmarks/mast_centroid_solve_panels.py`, `benchmarks/coil_edit_latency.py:_render_panel`).
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — each unit carries one deliverable: s5 a map builder, s6 four centroid panels, s7 five coil-edit panels.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — s6, s7 and s8 each declare `separatrix-spline-extraction#s5` in `plan-section-depends-on`, every named producer, test and figure path resolves, and no unit depends on a node that does not exist.
